quotes: Best Service I have experienced in a very busy NYC hotspot restaurant ever.
Well, they definitely favor their regulars.

themes.label: Bone marrow appetizer
themes.text: Mostly recommended as a must-order starter, though one reviewer found it excessively fatty.
quotes: The best bone marrow and hamburger in NYC.
the bone marrow was excessively fatty.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers note the high cost, with most saying the food quality or the burger justifies it and a few feeling it was too much.
quotes: Kind of pricey, but the quality of the food is very high.

themes.label: Crowded, noisy room
themes.text: Several find the space tight, loud and busy, while one enjoyed the cozy close quarters.
quotes: High quality food but cramped and noisy.
This is not a the best place for big groups. The space is very tight.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, friendly service, but a few describe rude or cold staff, a rushed feel and a reservation dispute.
quotes: Food is outstanding. Service is even better than the food.
The server was grumpy and cold, the meat was undercooked and chewy and the staff didn't seem happy.

themes.label: Meat quality
themes.text: Reviewers mostly rave about the quality and variety of the beef, though a few found some cuts chewy, raw or not special.
quotes: The meat quality was very good but I'd rather just go to a normal steakhouse that's not trying to be Korean.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some call it worth the splurge or fairly priced, while others find it expensive and say K-town offers similar quality for less.
quotes: Menu is expensive but really worth it, meat is spectacular and delicious.
not very much meat for the price though. I understand it's upscale and in New York

themes.label: Butcher's Feast and omakase
themes.text: The Butcher's Feast and omakase set menus are frequently recommended for their variety of cuts and sides, with minor complaints about some dishes.
quotes: Get the butcher's feast - you won't regret it
I would highly recommend the butcher's feast.

themes.label: Reservations and demand
themes.text: Reviewers say the restaurant is very busy and reservations are advised or hard to get, and one reported a reservation dispute.
quotes: it's extremely difficult to get a reservation after 5:30 or before 10:00 pm.
I would highly recommend that you make a reservation in advance as it is very popular.

themes.label: Coconut crab curry
themes.text: The coconut crab curry is repeatedly singled out as a must-order, though a few find it very spicy or merely ok.
quotes: The coconut crab curry truly is yummy! (It says this on the menu).
CRAB CURRY HELL YES. WE DRANK THE JUICE.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Staff are described as warm, friendly and attentive, though one reviewer found service average and another said it is sometimes thinly spread.
quotes: Service was very warm and welcoming would 100% recommend it!!
Service is always sweet, if sometimes a bit thinly spread.

themes.label: Happy hour oysters and drinks
themes.text: The $1 oysters and discounted cocktails at happy hour are a draw, though some found the oysters tiny.
quotes: Go there during happy hour. $1 oysters and cheap drinks. EVERY DAY.
The oysters were some of the tiniest I've ever been served

themes.label: Spice level
themes.text: Many praise the real, honest spice, while others found some dishes too hot to eat or not as hot as warned.
quotes: they are truthful about the spice level. I didn't have to beg them to make it spicy.
none of the dishes we ordered were extraordinarily hot even though the waiter warned us about one.

themes.label: Price and portions
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable with generous portions, while others call the food pricey or small for the cost.
quotes: Reasonable pricing, considerable portions and the employees are consistently welcoming.
the portions are small so you should both order something.

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Pizza is the most praised item, with reviewers singling out the crust, the margherita and the clam pizza, though a couple found the dough or value lacking.
quotes: The clam pizza is mind blowingly good
The crust is so soft and pillowy you just wanna hug it.

themes.label: High prices, small portions
themes.text: Many reviewers felt prices were steep for the portion sizes and flavour, though a few said the pizza was worth paying for.
quotes: This is a highly overpriced restaurant with small portions.
Quite expensive given how small the portions were (pizza, pasta).

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praised attentive, excellent service, but others found it rude, slow or not polished enough.
quotes: Super considerate wait staff. Really well designed restaurant with really great food.
Our server was a bit rude and I told her so....

themes.label: Wine list
themes.text: Reviewers mostly praised the wine selection and curation, although one found it too expensive with too few choices under $100.
quotes: Incredible wine list, amazing pizza
There were some choices below $100, but there seemed to be more choices above $200 than below $100.

themes.label: Atmosphere and setting
themes.text: Reviewers liked the lively, cozy, attractive room and open kitchen, with some enjoying the outdoor seating.
quotes: Incredible atmosphere, great food, excellent wine
Excellent food and a lively, fun atmosphere.

themes.label: Fresh homemade pasta
themes.text: Reviewers praise the fresh, handmade pasta and its sauces, naming rigatoni vodka, mafalde, cacio e pepe and lumache, with many calling it the best they've had.
quotes: The pasta was soooo fresh and delicious. I couldn't stop thinking about it for days.
Very fresh pasta made right in front of you. Great flavors.

themes.label: Sandwiches and meatballs
themes.text: Sandwiches, especially the meatball parm, Italian combo and Sicilian tuna, are repeatedly called delicious, though one reviewer found the combo pricey versus other shops.
quotes: One of the best meatball sandwiches I've ever had in my fatboy life
The Sicilian Tuna sandwich, wow wow wow so tasty and satisfying

themes.label: Price versus portion size
themes.text: Many reviewers find prices high for the small portions, around $13 to $16 for pasta, though some say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: It came to $15 with tax, and for the amount you got it really feels too expensive.
A little on the pricy side but definitely worth it because you're getting super fresh ingredients.

themes.label: Staff friendliness
themes.text: Most reviewers describe the staff as friendly and kind, but a few reported rude treatment, a wrong order and being blocked after an accessibility question.
quotes: The team behind the counter might be the friendliest people ever.
people are kinda rude for no reason

themes.label: Small, clean, cozy space
themes.text: Reviewers describe a small, casual, clean space with a cozy vibe, though seating is limited.
quotes: Not much room to sit, but the food is amazing.
A very clean place and cool vibe as well.

themes.label: Pasta quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the pastas, especially agnolotti and mafaldini, as excellent, though a few find other dishes less memorable.
quotes: Pastas are excellent. Swordfish entree is one of the best things I've ever eaten.
Top 3 pasta place in NYC. The non-pasta dishes were very forgettable, though.

themes.label: Reservations and wait times
themes.text: Reviewers describe booking far ahead, long door lines, and unclear or inaccurate wait quotes, with some turned away despite empty seats.

it's so good it's really hard to make a reservation there. The earliest you can do is at least 1 month in advance

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive, professional staff, while others found service pretentious, slow, rushed or dismissive.
quotes: Staff excellent from the GM to the waitress to the busser. Friendly and very accommodating. Never felt rushed.
It is italian, done ok, and a whole lotta noses in the air...

themes.label: Overrated hype
themes.text: Some reviewers found the food only good or average and not living up to the restaurant's reputation.
quotes: Not sure what the hype is about. The food was good but not great.
Thought it was Ok. Food was good. Service was good. Overrated.

themes.label: Atmosphere and space
themes.text: The room is described as beautiful, warm and lively, with pleasant outdoor seating, though one reviewer likened it to Restoration Hardware.
quotes: The vibe/ambience was warm and lively, the food was simply exquisite, and the service was exemplary.

themes.label: Food quality and flavor
themes.text: Most reviewers call the food delicious and inventive, singling out dishes like ceviche, quinoa salad, lomo saltado and tiradito.
quotes: Quinoa appetizer and cheviche are amazing. The roast chicken is great to share.
We loved the quinoa salad, corn cake with cheese and the salmon tiradito. The lomo saltado is amazing!!!

themes.label: Small portions, high prices
themes.text: Many reviewers found portions small and prices high, though a few felt the dishes were worth the cost.
quotes: $ 18 for a tiny portion of ceviche? $23 for a small seafood rice? I'm sorry but not worth it.
The food is great, but the servings are small so expect to spend more than you imagine at first.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive staff and bartenders, while others report rude management, declining quality, an over-attentive waiter, or an unconcerned hostess.
quotes: Delicious food, fantastic service, comfortable ambience
You'll have to wait even if you have a reservation and the hostess won't care.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers like the modern decor, vibe, music and rooftop, though a few note it is dark and noisy when full.
quotes: Great cocktails and beautiful design. Love the music and all the plush greenery hanging from the ceiling.
Interior is beautiful but too dark to read menus.

themes.label: Not traditional Peruvian
themes.text: Some Peruvian reviewers found the food too reinterpreted or pretentious, while others valued its creative, fusion take on Peruvian cuisine.

the chef has created his own concept using Peruvian flavors and ingredients.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly, helpful and accommodating, but a few described slow, neglectful or off-putting service at the bar and tables.
quotes: High quality food, professional wait staff
it wasn't busy but it took so long for service (at the bar!) that we got up to leave

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many praised the French dishes, brunch and mussels, though a few found dishes mediocre, cold or overcooked.
quotes: Had the two sets of mussels and both were fantastic!. Really excellent fries!
the other came cold and overcooked (like they took out yesterday's meat out of the fridge)

themes.label: Garden and ambiance
themes.text: Reviewers liked the cozy, romantic atmosphere and especially the back patio garden with its small lights.
quotes: Excellent happy hour and an absolutely beautiful patio garden area.
the outside patio atmosphere, it was just mesmerizing with all the tiny light bulbs

themes.label: Oyster happy hour
themes.text: Reviewers enjoyed the cheap oysters and drink specials during happy hour.
quotes: delicious and cheap oyster deal and good drinks to go with it all. Great happy hour.
Loved the dollar oyster special.

themes.label: Cocktail quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the cocktails as tasty, inventive and well crafted, though a few found them disappointing or poorly mixed.

themes.label: Speakeasy decor and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers love the intimate, hidden speakeasy feel and the decor, especially the back room, and see it as a good date spot.
quotes: Each room has a different decor as you make your way back to the bar, incredible low light atmosphere.
Beautiful thematic decor and cozy welcoming vibe

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Many praise friendly, knowledgeable bartenders and service, but some report rude hosts or management, unrequested checks and a slow food order.
quotes: The bartenders are very knowledgable about everything they serve and quite passionate.
The rudest front of office staff - they should be fired.

themes.label: Waits and reservations

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers note that drinks are expensive, though some feel the service and atmosphere justify the cost.
quotes: The prices are steep but the service and atmosphere are well worth it.

themes.label: Margaritas and drinks
themes.text: Margaritas get the most praise, with several calling them the best they've had, and happy hour drinks are also liked.

This place makes the best margaritas in EV, hands down.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers found the staff friendly, attentive and accommodating, but a few reported slow or rude service.

themes.label: Tacos and flavor
themes.text: Many loved the tacos and other dishes, while some found the food bland, oily or merely standard.

themes.label: Waits and reservations
themes.text: Reviewers report waits for tables, especially at weekends, and advise booking ahead or going early.
quotes: there's often a hefty wait time, particularly on Sundays and after work.
although there is usually a wait on a saturday, if you have a craving for Mexican food, it is worth the wait.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Several reviewers felt the restaurant was pricey or poor value, even when they liked the food.
quotes: Overall a good experience but way too pricey for the value.
even though the food was great and so were the drinks, it's really pricey.

themes.label: Jerusalem sesame bagel
themes.text: The bagel with lima bean dip is repeatedly singled out as a highlight, though a few reviewers found it merely good.
quotes: The sesame bagel is so fluffy and light. Absolutely delicious.
Make sure you leave enough room after the Jerusalem Bagel which was the highlight of the meal.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many reviewers found the dishes expensive for small portions, though a few felt the creativity or occasion justified the cost.
quotes: Delicious but outrageously expensive... it's nyc but come on
very expensive for small pieces of meals.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praised friendly, knowledgeable staff, but others reported slow service, long waits, aloofness or impolite waiters.
quotes: Knowledgeable and warm service makes you feel more like a guest at a wonderful dinner party
we waited almost an HOUR for the appetizers, and a very long tine for the mains as well.

themes.label: Creative flavors
themes.text: Reviewers praised the inventive, unusual flavor combinations and fresh dishes such as the smoked eggplant carpaccio and octopus.

food was very innovative but still true to the middle eastern flavors.

themes.label: Noisy small room

yes it is loud but that's typical for NYC as is the close table seating.

themes.label: Pizza quality and sourdough crust
themes.text: Most reviewers call the pizza among the best they have had, praising the sourdough crust and toppings, though a few found it unremarkable.
quotes: Favorite pizza in NYC. Sourdough crust. Natural wines. Great vibes.
this is probably the best pizza I've ever had. Better than any pizza literally anywhere in the US or any other country for that matter.

themes.label: Natural wine and drinks
themes.text: Many praise the natural wine selection, beers and cocktails, but one reviewer disliked having no wine list and another found drinks expensive.
quotes: Every wine was offered by the glass at very reasonable prices, excellent selection of natural wine.
Not having a wine list isn't cool, it's just a major bummer.

themes.label: Friendly staff and service
themes.text: Staff are repeatedly described as friendly, kind and accommodating, though a few reviewers reported inattentive, disorganized or attitude-laden service.
quotes: Delicious pizza and thoughtful staff that help you choose from a seasonal menu and rotating offerings of wines by the glass.
When they didn't have the wine I originally wanted our server brought over two similar wines and let me taste both to make a decision!

themes.label: Waits and crowding
themes.text: Reviewers warn the restaurant gets busy and advise arriving early or being ready to wait, with one reporting a nearly two-hour wait.

I'd recommend going on a weeknight or being prepared to wait.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere, tiny tables
themes.text: The room is often described as cozy and good for dates, though some note the tables are very small and unsuited to larger groups.

Cozy , lovely place. Nice music

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find it overpriced, especially the kimbap, while others say the food is worth the money or the prices are fair.
quotes: Skip the kimbap section, they're way overpriced and not worth it.
It's a whole vibe and it's worth the money.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff, but a few describe rude, forgetful or slow service.
quotes: Great service and knowledgeable staff
Service in the other hand was super bad.

themes.label: White pepper wings
themes.text: The white pepper wings are repeatedly named as a must-order, tasty dish.
quotes: White pepper wings were great and the rice cake dish with parmesan & truffle
White pepper wings were super tasty.

themes.label: Saltiness and food quality
themes.text: Several reviewers found dishes too salty or mediocre, though many others called the food delicious.

Food a little too salty for my taste and also on the pricey side.

themes.label: Hudson Yards location

good eating/drinking experience, terrible, tasteless location.

themes.label: Friendly, efficient service

Workers are nice, helpful and prompt with your order.

themes.label: Salty ramen broth

quotes: The problem isn't how spicy it is, but how much salt is in it.
Too salty..nothing special. I like Ippudo better.

themes.label: Shrimp tempura buns and appetizers
themes.text: Shrimp tempura buns, pork buns and other appetizers are often singled out as delicious.
quotes: the tempura shrimp in the steam bun and pork dumplings were by far the best
Get the apps too, they're fantastic!

themes.label: Reasonable prices and portions
themes.text: Reviewers describe the prices as fair and the bowls as generous or filling, though one found beer pricey.
quotes: the bowls are pretty big so the price ain't bad.

themes.label: Broth and ramen quality

quotes: Their broth is a lot more layered than most places I've tried.

themes.label: Food quality and freshness

I found the majority of food way too salty.

themes.label: Service quality

quotes: Service was friendly and efficient, and the ambiance is cozy and warm.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers mostly like the beautiful, cozy room, though some find it crammed, loud, dark or noisy.

the ambience is relaxed but nice enough for any occasion

themes.label: Pizza and starters

still had to wait 30 mins to be seated

themes.label: Service and warm hosting

themes.label: Atmosphere and interior

themes.label: Long waits and seating

themes.label: Cocktails and drinks

quotes: the cocktails are a stunning complement to the meal.

themes.label: High prices

quotes: The slots are very tight. Out of the last 15 or so times I have went here I've had no luck.
Me and my boi had great time we came up like 900 in less than a hour

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers often describe the casino as beautiful, nice-looking and relaxing, with a friendly feel and good music.
quotes: Had a absolute blast, the decor is outstanding and the food was great
Because it is beautiful and quiet

themes.label: Food and drinks
themes.text: Some praise the burgers, steak and dinner, while others call the food overpriced or limited and the drinks expensive.
quotes: Had dinner at the Prime restaurant, steak was mind blowing.
The food is just overpriced Chinese and fast food.

themes.label: Staff and floor service
themes.text: Some find staff friendly and service great, but others report too few cashiers and floor agents, slow help and lack of service.
quotes: not enough agents on the floor to respond to malfunctions. Held hostage for 48mins at broke machine
Friendly staff and crowd. Cant wait to go back

themes.label: Security and safety
themes.text: Opinions split: some praise visible security and cleanliness, while others cite weak security, fights and shady people.
quotes: most importantly security for everyone
8 out of 10 times there's always a fight; people that go there behave crazy

themes.label: Pastrami and sandwich quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the pastrami, corned beef and Reuben as tender, flavorful and the best they've had, though a few find them overhyped.
quotes: Best pastrami in the world. A must everytime I'm in New York!
the meat is incredibly flavory and tender. This is a must go in NY.

themes.label: Long lines and waits
themes.text: Many describe long, crowded lines but say they move quickly and are worth it; others find the ordering slow and disorganized.
quotes: Long lines but worth the wait.
Always busy but lines move quickly.

themes.label: Huge portions
themes.text: Sandwiches and fries are very large, and reviewers often suggest sharing one between two people.
quotes: Portions were huge. I'd recommend splitting a sandwich.
sandwiches so thick you will not go hungry

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many call the sandwiches expensive, around $20 or more, though several say the quality justifies the cost.
quotes: It may be $20 for a sandwich and a couple pickles- but it is WORTH it, at least once!
it's food is way overrated and expensive

themes.label: Ticket system and ordering
themes.text: Some visitors found the ticket system, multiple lines and self-seating confusing or overwhelming.
quotes: A little confusing where to go, which line is which.
you need to know the system if your going to order and seat yourself

themes.label: Steak quality
themes.text: Most reviewers call the porterhouse and steak outstanding, often the best in New York, though a few find it overrated or only okay.
quotes: As good as it gets. Don't know why they even bother putting salt and pepper on the table.
Definitely New York's best steak by a mile.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many praise friendly, attentive waiters, but others describe rude, arrogant or unprofessional servers and a curt reception.
quotes: the service is top notch delivered by old school waiters
Arrogant waiters, treating without caring and attention with customers.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Reviewers note the high cost; many say it is worth it, while some call it overpriced or a trap.
quotes: Expensive, yes, but it's totally worth it.
slightly over priced but overall worth a visit

themes.label: Waits and reservations
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits, seating delays despite bookings, and difficulty getting a reservation.
quotes: We had a reservation but still waited about 30 minutes for our table
we weren't seated until nearly 15 minutes after our booking

themes.label: Bacon and sides
themes.text: The thick-cut bacon, creamed spinach and onion rings earn praise, though one reviewer found the sides mediocre.
quotes: The bacon is amazingly thick, crunchy and flavorful.
Skip the sides they're mediocre at best.

themes.label: Cheesecake quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the cheesecake as delicious and the best they have had, though a few found it crumbled, sour, or only okay.
quotes: Mind blowing New York cheesecake. It's a must try!
the cheesecake was horrible. It was all crumbled up in pieces.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, fast, attentive service, but some report slow service, an unwelcoming staff member, or mistakes with orders.
quotes: The service is as good as it gets here and the food was delicious.
Even though it was empty service was pretty slow, and the waitress messed up the drinks.

themes.label: Large portions
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly mention generous, huge portions of food and desserts.
quotes: The portions are HUGE!! We had the steak burgers with Swiss. So good!
they always give generous portions and the food is really fresh.

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or fair, while others call them high or not worth the quality of the meals.
quotes: The cheesecake is great...but the prices are kinda high.

themes.label: Savory food quality
themes.text: Opinions on non-dessert food vary: some praise burgers, sandwiches and onion rings, while others found meals average, cold, stale or spoiled.
quotes: Best onion rings I've ever come across.
Ordered pastrami bread was stale so disappointed.

themes.label: Pizza quality and crust
themes.text: Many call it among the best pizza, with a great crust, while others find it average, bland, burnt, dry or tough.
quotes: Great classic New York pizza. Best crust ever.
The pizza was burnt all over (not in a good way) and the pie was tough.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Reviewers often call the pizza expensive or overpriced, with some saying it is not worth the cost, though a few accept it.
quotes: Add on the fact that a 18" pie here costs north of $25 and it's absolutely crazy that this place is still in business.
Not exactly cheap, but absolutely worth a visit!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, attentive and fast service, though a few mention slow ordering or very low service.
quotes: Best pizza in NY! Fast, friendly service.
Very good service and good recommendations from the waiter, to repeat

themes.label: Waiting time and crowds
themes.text: Reviewers report long waits and a packed restaurant, with some saying the wait is worth it and others finding it frustrating.
quotes: The hour long wait is always worth it.
We waited 30 minutes to be served quickly, because many people wait.

themes.label: History and atmosphere
themes.text: Many value the restaurant's history as the first pizzeria and its characterful, authentic atmosphere, though some call it a tourist trap.
quotes: Great place with good pizza, history and atmosphere.
It's historic. They've been open since 1905

themes.label: Classic New York slice
themes.text: Many reviewers call it an authentic, classic New York slice with a thin crispy crust, though a few say the flavor is underwhelming.
quotes: This place is exactly that. Simple, humble, but classic and delicious. It's the perfect balance of bread, sauce and cheese with a nice crunch.
Margarita slice didn't have as much flavor as the long lines would make you think.

themes.label: Fast line service
themes.text: Reviewers say lines are common but move quickly and slices are served almost instantly.
quotes: Don't let the lines discourage you, THE SERVICE IS QUICK.
The line moves quickly so despite the line it's not a long wait.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Most find slices cheap and good value, but a couple feel about $3 a slice is overpriced for what it is.
quotes: Fast, cheap and tasty food.
Tourist trap, overpriced and overrated.

themes.label: Staff and service attitude
themes.text: Some praise friendly, efficient staff, while others report rude cashiers, a change mistake, or no masks during the pandemic.
quotes: Theres usually a line but they are lightning fast and pretty friendly.
the service was horrible they all had a horrible attitude and threw change onto the counter and walked away

themes.label: Celebrity photos and atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the small, no-frills room with celebrity photos and its history, though space inside is limited.
quotes: the place is small and is covered in pictures of Joe with everyone famous you could ever imagine
the place has a good vibe, great price and history.

themes.label: Pepperoni square slice
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the square or Sicilian pepperoni slice as the standout, praising its crisp crust, fresh-from-the-oven heat and flavor.
quotes: The square pepperoni slice is the best pepperoni pizza in nyc. It's like crack, so addicting
Try the rectangular pepperoni slices -- they come fresh out of the oven and are unbelievably good.

themes.label: Long lines and waits
themes.text: Most say the line is long, sometimes over an hour, but worth it; a few complain about slow ordering and waiting.
quotes: Yes, you have to wait in line with tourists, but it's worth it.

themes.label: Small space, no seating
themes.text: Reviewers note the shop is tiny with no seats, so people eat standing at counters or on the sidewalk.
quotes: No real spots to eat so be prepared to eat standing somewhere on the sidewalk.
Just as long as you know you can't sit down here, it's great.

themes.label: Staff attitude
themes.text: Several reviewers found the staff unfriendly or rude, though one early review called the service friendly.
quotes: the staffs are rude and the place is really tiny
The staff can be more friendly and helpful.

themes.label: Price
themes.text: Some call prices fair or reasonable, while others say it costs too much for a slice or a whole pie.
quotes: Great pizza at reasonable prices.
35 bucks for a pizza that tastes like straight up digiorno? I'm good.

themes.label: Variety of vendors and food
themes.text: Reviewers praise the wide range of food stalls, shops and cuisines, from groceries and meat to prepared food and coffee, all under one roof.
quotes: A conglomerate of independent stores, great grocery shopping, fish market, fruits and vegetables, meat market, breads, coffees, cheeses.
A great assortment of restaurants, and market-style shops. A great place to go and grab a bite with friends.

themes.label: Fresh produce and groceries
themes.text: Shoppers say the fruit, vegetables, meat and fish are fresh and good for everyday grocery shopping.
quotes: Excellent place to get fresh fruits and vegetables and from different countries
Fresh fruit and vegetables Meats and Seafood at great prices

themes.label: Prices
themes.text: Some find prices reasonable or cheaper than supermarkets, while others say the new market has become pricey, with some vendors very expensive.
quotes: It seems a bit pricier, but you can't fault them for that.
You can get lunch there for under $10 and enjoy the ambiance of the space!

themes.label: New space and seating
themes.text: Many like the new, clean, spacious building with plenty of seating, though some miss the old market and one wants more seating and bathrooms.
quotes: Great quality and huge space upstairs for sitting.
I wish they had more seating and an easy to find bathroom.

themes.label: Old market nostalgia
themes.text: Several reviewers miss the old market's character, though many are glad the community feel and vendors were largely kept.
quotes: Beautiful new space, and great to see lots of the old vendors still there!
While I love the openness of this new location, it really makes me miss the old one.

themes.label: Pierogi quality
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly single out the pierogies, fried or boiled, as exceptional, delicious and a reason to return.
quotes: The fried pierogies are no joke. Best ones I've ever had.

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, fast, attentive staff, but one found late-night service very slow and another found it prompt but not friendly.
quotes: any requests made to the waitress took too long. even when we asked for the bill, it took forever.
Service is Excellent. Very Friendly and Fast.

themes.label: Borscht
themes.text: Borscht is praised as a standout, with several reviewers calling it the best they have had.
quotes: Best borscht you will ever eat.
The borscht will star in your dreams

themes.label: Open late, 24 hours
themes.text: Reviewers value that it is open around the clock and works well for late-night meals.
quotes: Best quick bite late night stip.
I went in at 2:30 AM after a night of drinking and was surprised by this place.

themes.label: Prices and crowds
themes.text: Many call prices reasonable or great value, though one found brunch eggs not worth the price, one called dinner pricey, and others noted crowding.
quotes: The food is great, authentic and not too expensive. 24 hour too!
just wasn't impressed with them for the price I paid

themes.label: All-you-can-eat value
themes.text: Most reviewers call the all-you-can-eat buffet, including Groupon deals, a cheap and worthwhile bargain, though a few say it is not truly unlimited or has hidden costs.
quotes: For 28$ it's all you can eat for two hours. That's insane!
Great all-you-can-eat deal. It's not phenomenal but it's a really good deal and hits the spot.

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Many praise friendly, fast service, but others report rude staff, little attention at the table, or poor service.
quotes: Amazing Japanese dishes and great sushi. Very friendly service. Will return.
Last week service was terrible. The sushi was not fresh and the sashimi was badly cut. Server was also rude.

themes.label: Sushi freshness and quality
themes.text: Many describe the fish as fresh and tasty, while others find the quality mediocre or below a la carte restaurants.
quotes: The fish was incredibly fresh and the menu had few limitations.
the sushi though good for the all you can eat price is not as good as a alacart restaurants

themes.label: iPad ordering system
themes.text: Ordering through a tablet at the table is liked as practical and convenient, though some had missing items or no staff check-ins.
quotes: Very practical system with iPad to control
I like how they can order from an iPad

themes.label: Mandatory tip and cash only
themes.text: Reviewers object to an automatic 18% tip that cannot be removed, and to limited payment options such as cash only.
quotes: You cannot decrease the built in tip.
there is a non-optional 18% service fee added to the bill

themes.label: Service quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise attentive, professional service, but a few report slow, stretched, bored or unprofessional staff.
quotes: So impressed with the service quality. They really take good care of you and the food is always perfect.
The staff seemed bored and while they were attentive you got the feeling that they would prefer to be anywhere but at work.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious, but some find it average or mediocre, or the meat tough.
quotes: Food is delicious ! Whatever u take !
The food is mediocre for what they charge.

themes.label: High prices
themes.text: Many find it pricey, with some saying it is worth it and others calling it overpriced for what is served.
quotes: Yes, they are high priced, but given the location and the quality of the food, it makes sense.
Overpriced for what it was. Drinks overpriced and so were steak and desserts.

themes.label: Crowds and noise
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as packed, noisy and hard to get into, with long waits and tightly spaced tables.
quotes: the tables are glued to each other and there is a lot of noise.
Nice place but super crowded and hard to walk around the restaurant.

themes.label: Bakery, bread and pastries
themes.text: Reviewers single out the bread, croissants, sticky bun, coconut cake and other pastries as excellent.
quotes: Literally the best croissants I have had in America, and almost as good as you'll find in France.
Love love love the bakery! The sticky bun is sooo good!

themes.label: Food quality and variety
themes.text: Many reviewers praise delicious Spanish food and a wide choice of dishes, drinks and stalls, with tapas, cured meats and octopus singled out.
quotes: Great energy, food (quality and variety) and drink! A fun time
there are many delicious things to eat

themes.label: Paella disappointing
themes.text: Several reviewers found the paella dry, lacking flavor or marginal, though one praised a squid ink paella and another liked it.
quotes: skip the paella it's not great as it's dry, unsatisfying and really just not as good compared to the tapas available nearby
The paella was not good, it lacks flavor, more meat, the portions are small and expensive.

themes.label: Crowds, noise and seating
themes.text: Reviewers describe the market as crowded, noisy and cramped, with too little seating and long lines.
quotes: They could have benefited from having more seating, or at least high tops to stand around while you enjoy your food.
Very noisy. Limited seating. Overcrowded.

themes.label: Prices and portions
themes.text: Some call prices reasonable or good value, while others find food and drinks expensive with small portions; one found tapas portions huge.
quotes: Great value for the money considering it's in NYC.

themes.label: Atmosphere and Spanish feel
themes.text: Many enjoyed the lively, beautiful market setting and its Spanish feel, though a few said it did not feel like a real mercado.
quotes: this place is just thriving...burgeoning with life!!!
Good atmosphere. It reminded me of being in Barcelona.

themes.label: Waterfront and bridge views
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the views of the Brooklyn and Manhattan bridges, the river and the city skyline, especially from the pier end and rooftop.
quotes: Three bridge scene is unbeatable with a drink from the Heineken bar.
Best view of the city especially at sun down

themes.label: Concerts and events
themes.text: Many visitors came for rooftop concerts and events and found it a great venue, though some had complaints about sound and entry lines.
quotes: Great place for a concert. Must go to
Here for Ringo Starr anf his All Star Band, a great concert venue.

themes.label: Limited shops and food
themes.text: Several reviewers found few shops, restaurants or things to do, with the old mall gone and the development still unfinished.
quotes: Great venue. Lack of food options though.
I'm disappointed that the mall isn't even a mall anymore.

themes.label: Rooftop ice skating
themes.text: Visitors enjoyed the elevated ice skating rink in winter, calling it amazing and fun.
quotes: Rooftop ice skating was amazing!
So much fun and I absolutely love the ice skating rink!

themes.label: Staff, security and queues
themes.text: A few reviewers complained about poor service, long security lines and unenforced no-smoking rules, while one praised helpful staff and funny bartenders.
quotes: A 30 minute queue for security is unacceptable.
Great space and helpful staff! Had a blast here, can't wait to go back!

themes.label: Cannoli quality
themes.text: Cannoli are repeatedly called the best, with one reviewer finding the shells pale and stale and the quality sub-standard.
quotes: The Best cannoli in New York
Best cannoli I've had in my life!

themes.label: Pastries and desserts
themes.text: Reviewers praise the variety and taste of the Italian pastries, cakes and desserts, calling them flaky, delicious and authentic.
quotes: Best Italian pastries ever (in America)
Pastries are so yummy and flaky.

themes.label: Gelato quality and price
themes.text: Some find the gelato delicious, while others call it tiny, overpriced, crumbly or bad for the money.
quotes: The Nutella gelato was delicious and we got to sit outside.
They charge 9.00 for a tiny scoop of bad gelato!!!

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many describe friendly, attentive staff, but others report rude servers, slow service and long waits at the counter.
quotes: the staff friendly and attentive but not overbearing
35 people waiting for baked goods.. 2 behind the counter.. We left

themes.label: Prices and tourist feel
themes.text: Several reviewers find prices high and call the place a tourist trap, though some accept the cost for the area.
quotes: I now feel that it is more of a tourist destination (trap?) than a must go.
Only wish it wasn't as expensive, though you can't expect anything cheaper for NYC.

themes.label: Burger quality
themes.text: Many reviewers call the burgers among the best they have had, praising taste and juiciness, though a few find them overrated or not special.
quotes: Best burgers ever. Always consistent!
Meh, I don't know what the noise is all about. I've had better burgers in local diners and without standing on line.

themes.label: Crowded, limited seating
themes.text: Reviewers often say the place is packed, with long lines and too few tables, making it hard to sit and enjoy the meal.
quotes: Delicious! but busy room. It's not enough space for you to sit.
the place is packed, you can't find a place to sit down and enjoy your meal.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Staff are mostly described as friendly, attentive and welcoming, with one review noting staff who were not friendly in parts.
quotes: Employees were so welcoming and cashiers were enthusiastic.
Staff in parts not friendly

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Many find prices reasonable and good value, while some call the food overpriced or a bit pricey.
quotes: Definitely competitive prices compared to other chains of the same kind, let's say an unbeatable value for money.
Great food but highly overrated and overpriced.

themes.label: Fries and shakes
themes.text: Fries and shakes are singled out as excellent, including crispy fries and cheese fries.
quotes: the potatoes are the best I've ever tasted! Crispy on the outside, and tender on the inside!

themes.label: Long waiting times
themes.text: Many reviewers warn of long waits, sometimes up to two hours, though some say it was worth it and a few were seated quickly.
quotes: Come at a silly time or else be prepared to wait... and wait... and wait...
Wait was almost 90 minutes on a Friday night.

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most praise the broth, noodle texture and flavor, some calling it the city's best, while others find it overrated, too salty or with hard noodles.
quotes: The broth is super rich and the noodles with just the right amount of chew and bounce.
The noodles too hard and soups only taste salty very salty.

themes.label: Atmosphere and decor
themes.text: Reviewers describe the place as fun, lively and inviting, with a pleasant mood and decor, though one found the music too loud.
quotes: I love the atmosphere, which is always inviting.
delicious food, fun vibe and very reasonably priced for the quality and experience

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Most describe friendly, attentive and quick service, but a few found staff unfriendly, rushed or declining over time.
quotes: The staff is attentive, but not crowding.
Unfortunately, service has been on a downwards trend and it no longer feels as welcoming or service minded

themes.label: Pork buns and sides
themes.text: Pork buns and other small plates are repeatedly praised as delicious.
quotes: The pork steamed buns were the best I've ever had.

themes.label: Crispy thin crust
themes.text: Reviewers repeatedly praise the thin, crispy, crunchy crust and well-balanced sauce and cheese, though one reviewer found the crust like cardboard.
quotes: the crust was crispy and crunchy. I love crispy and crunch on pizza and these guys nailed it.
Crispy, tasty classic New York thin crust pizza. Top quality, friendly staff

themes.label: Prices and value
themes.text: Many reviewers call the prices reasonable or good value for large slices, though one found two slices fairly expensive.
quotes: The size is huge for the dinner. And the price is super reasonable.
Nice bang for your buck for good tasting pizza..

themes.label: Limited seating, crowding
themes.text: The place is small with few seats, so it gets crowded and seating can be difficult, especially with tour groups.
quotes: the inside is super small so seating can be tough especially when a pizza tour comes by.
There isn't much seating so be prepared to either wait for a seat or take a slice to-go.

themes.label: Staff and service
themes.text: Most reviewers describe friendly, fast, attentive staff, but a few report rude counter workers or a rushed single waiter.
quotes: It was fast, orderly and professional. Great experience.
The counter worker had an attitude.

themes.label: Nonna Maria slice
themes.text: The Nonna Maria slice is singled out by several reviewers as the one to order.
quotes: Nonna Maria. Get it. Love it. One of the best pizzas in the city

themes.label: Ramen quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the ramen as the best they've had, though a few found the broth bland, greasy or not memorable.
quotes: The ramen is so good that all other ramen will likely pale in comparison.
Broth tastes literally just like water, ramen is not bad, but they don't offer firm noodle.

themes.label: Waiting and crowds
themes.text: Reviewers expect long waits and crowds, with most saying the wait is worth it and suggesting going early or at lunch.
quotes: Worth the wait. Put your name down and stroll around.
You should bring a little time, because it can not be reserved and the rush is very high.

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Service is mostly described as great, knowledgeable and kind, but some reported a rude hostess, rushing and an impatient waitress.
quotes: he offered to make me a new dish, or something else for no charge
hostess was rude and misinformed and waiters rushed us from the moment we sat down.

themes.label: Buns and small plates
themes.text: Pork buns, shrimp buns and other starters or sides are praised as delicious.
quotes: I definitely recommend the shrimp bun and mushroom bun (vegetarian!).
Steam buns here we're the best I've had and the ramen was top notch.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Several reviewers found the food pricey or poor value for what they got, though one called it the best for the money.
quotes: Really cool and delicious, but damn expensive for what you get
Probably best for the money in NYC.

themes.label: Friendly attentive service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive staff and good service, though a few describe rude staff, slow service or being rushed.
quotes: Super good service and friendly staff. Come at 5:30pm and there is no line with lots of the seats available.
They rushed me with a check and the waiter was rude as hell.

themes.label: Food quality and variety
themes.text: Many find the hot pot and BBQ tasty, fresh and varied, but some report a limited selection, dry beef and tired vegetables.
quotes: Food is good and fresh with a variety of meats, seafood and vegetables.
Pretty small selection, beef is very dry, and cuts are quite thick.

themes.label: Birthday celebrations
themes.text: Reviewers enjoy the free birthday meal and the costumed monkey or bear who sings and dances at the table.
quotes: Free hot pot on your birthday. Service is great.
Birthday monkey is so cute hehe :3

themes.label: Value and all-you-can-eat
themes.text: Reviewers see the all-you-can-eat format as good value, with cheap beers, though some say portions are excessive or staff skimp on BBQ.
quotes: Food is totally worth the money and there is a wide variety.
Good quality and worth the money.

themes.label: Space and atmosphere
themes.text: The place is described as spacious, clean and lively and good for groups, though the basement is noisy and one visit was empty.
quotes: Okay place, super noisy in the underground diner room. It's part of the hotpot feeling, but that was too much for us.
dining area was clean (there's a basement with additional seating!)

themes.label: Attentive, friendly service
themes.text: Most reviewers praise friendly, attentive and helpful servers, often by name, though one found servers slow and inattentive and another felt rushed.
quotes: Our waitress, Shanna, was more than happy and patient to help adjust the order to suit our preferences.
Would've been a 5 but the servers were slow and inattentive

themes.label: Pasta and carbonara
themes.text: Pasta dishes, especially the carbonara, are repeatedly called delicious, fresh and perfectly cooked, and several reviewers recommend them.
quotes: This place had the best pasta I have ever had in my entire life. It completely just melts in your mouth!
Great classic fresh carbonara. Amazing hand made pasta!

themes.label: Pizza quality
themes.text: Many enjoyed the brick oven pizza and its gluten free option, but two reviewers found the crust or flavor disappointing.
quotes: Excellent wood oven Italian pizza. The Margherita was delicious!
Went there for the pizza, the crust was disgusting. Worst italien pizza that I ever had.

themes.label: Atmosphere and ambiance
themes.text: Reviewers like the charming, lively setting, including indoor and outdoor seating, though one found it a bit noisy and another thought the music tacky.
quotes: Love the indoor/outdoor atmosphere.
Playing nightclub music while trying to pull off an authentic Italian vibe.

themes.label: Price and value
themes.text: Some reviewers found the place expensive, including overpriced wine and small portions, while others said the price is justified by quality.
quotes: Litle bit expensive, but it is necessary to keep the quality.
The wine is overpriced too.

themes.label: Thin-crust pizza quality
themes.text: Most reviewers praise the thin, crisp pizza and its sauce, with many calling it among the best in NYC, though a few found it average.
quotes: Ordered the classic pizza...paper thin crust and really tasty sauce. Put on your list for sure.
Cracker-thin crusts and excellent toppings. Can't go wrong with the Supreme or Tie-Dye.

themes.label: Wait times and reservations
themes.text: Reviewers describe waits from 15 minutes to 2.5 hours and hard-to-get tables, though many say it is worth it and advise booking.
quotes: Did have to wait 2.5 hours for our table though so come with that in mind
They keep some tables for walk in but be ready to wait between 15-45min... totally worth it!

themes.label: Pasta and meatballs
themes.text: Pasta and meatballs earn praise as handmade, rich and flavorful, with one reviewer calling the pasta the best they have had.
quotes: The meatballs were stunning. These were the best I had in years.
Probably the best handmade pasta I've ever had

themes.label: Service
themes.text: Most reviewers found staff friendly, attentive and helpful, but one called service horrible and rude and another found it unexceptional.
quotes: Servers were attentive and helpful.
The service is absolutely horrible, and straight up rude.

themes.label: Cozy atmosphere
themes.text: Reviewers describe the room as cozy, fun and relaxed, and good for groups.
quotes: Great pizzas and really fun, relaxed, local feel.
Cozy atmosphere, friendly staff

themes.label: Service and staff
themes.text: Many reviewers praise friendly, quick staff, while others report slow service, rude or unprofessional waiters, and understaffing.
quotes: Nice staff. Quick Service. Food is good. Clean environment.

themes.label: Food quality
themes.text: Many call the food delicious and hearty, but others found it tasteless, cold, stale, or poorly cooked.
quotes: That food is so delicious, and it is so much more than pancakes and French Toast.
